description: This source file defines the EspetaculosController, a Java class annotated as a VRaptor resource, responsible for handling web requests related to 'Espetaculo' entities, including listing, adding, scheduling sessions, and reserving tickets within a ticketing application.

classes.name: EspetaculosController
classes.description: Controller class for managing 'Espetaculo' entities and related web actions in a VRaptor framework application.

methods.name: lista
methods.description: Handles HTTP GET requests to list all 'Espetaculo' entities and includes 'estabelecimentos' in the result.

methods.name: adiciona
methods.description: Handles HTTP POST requests to add a new 'Espetaculo' after validating its name and description.

methods.name: sessao
methods.description: Handles HTTP GET requests to retrieve details of a specific 'Sessao' by its ID.

methods.name: reserva
methods.description: Handles ticket reservation requests for a specific 'Sessao'.

methods.name: sessoes
methods.description: Handles HTTP GET requests to list 'Sessoes' for a given 'Espetaculo'.

methods.name: cadastraSessoes
methods.description: Handles HTTP POST requests to create multiple 'Sessoes' for an 'Espetaculo' based on input dates, time, and periodicity.

methods.name: carregaEspetaculo
methods.description: Private helper method to load an 'Espetaculo' by its ID, redirecting to 'notFound' if not found.

methods.name: criaEstabelecimento
methods.description: Private helper method to create an 'Estabelecimento' (not used in core logic).
